elements.requirement: A company is not chargeable to corporation tax on profits that accrue to it in a fiduciary or representative capacity.
elements.quote: A company is not chargeable to corporation tax on profits which accrue to it in a fiduciary or representative capacity

elements.requirement: A company remains chargeable to corporation tax on profits accruing to it in a fiduciary or representative capacity as respects its own beneficial interest, if any, in those profits.
elements.quote: except as respects its own beneficial interest (if any) in the profits

elements.requirement: The exception from corporation tax chargeability for profits accruing in a fiduciary or representative capacity does not apply to profits arising in the winding up of the company.
elements.quote: The exception under subsection (1) from chargeability does not apply to profits arising in the winding up of the company
